answer: Juries must span at least three provenance groups, and a confirmation counts only after three reviewers from different groups agree. Idle identities lose standing each epoch they skip, so a parked account decays while the farm waits for a payout window. Cleverness does not help, because a velvet set of aliases drawn from one group forms one voice at the panel. Holding a mesa of silent accounts costs more per epoch than working a river of real tasks.
